title: Amelia | Garden-Print Blouse in Soft Blue
bodyHtml:
A blouse that does the heavy lifting for you—fresh garden florals and birds in striking blue on a cream base that works with everything in your wardrobe. Amelia brings that effortless elegance you're after, whether you're heading to the office or catching up with friends. Soft and breathable, it's the kind of piece you'll reach for again and again.

Why you'll love it

  • Garden-print design with intricate florals and birds—eye-catching without trying too hard
  • Relaxed fit with button-down front that skims without clinging
  • All-day comfort—light enough for warm days, polished enough for the boardroom
  • Pairs beautifully with white trousers for a classic look, or navy for something a little bolder
  • Machine washable and easy to care for—no fuss required
  • Works just as well dressed up with jewellery or down with your favourite weekend jeans
  • Cream base keeps it versatile; the blue tones mean it goes with almost everything you own

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
